claim: Vol 16 Ch 1 scope: policy applies to debts owed to DoD by any person except another Federal agency; procedures in other chapters
quote: Policy and requirements in this volume apply to administrative actions associated with the collection and disposition of debts that are owed to the DoD by any person, organization, or entity except another Federal agency.

claim: Marine pay waiver and remission procedures sit in Vol 7A Ch 50
quote: 8.1.1.1 5 U.S.C. 5584, 10 U.S.C. 2774 ... waive an indebtedness ... 9.0 REMISSION OR CANCELLATION OF INDEBTEDNESS
fix: Waiver and remission sit in Vol 16 Ch 4 sec 8.0 and 9.0. Vol 7A Ch 50 is Bankruptcy. Fix every Vol 7A Ch 50 reference on all s1g1-waivers pages.

claim: 10 USC 6161 is the Navy and Marine Corps enlisted remission authority
quote: Title 10 U.S.C. 7837, 10 U.S.C. 8271, and 10 U.S.C. 9837 provide authority for the remission or cancellation of indebtedness due from a military member.
fix: Cite 10 USC 7837 for the Navy and Marine Corps. Remission covers any overpayment of active duty pay, not hardship only.

claim: 10 USC 2774 military waiver authority for erroneous payment
quote: 5 U.S.C. 5584, 10 U.S.C. 2774, and 32 U.S.C. 716 provide the head of an executive agency with the authority to waive an indebtedness that is the result of an erroneous payment

claim: DOHA is the independent hearing officer for due process hearings under Ch 4
quote: Generally, DCMO hearing officials will process all requests for hearings.
fix: DCMO hearing officials hold due process hearings. DOHA decides waiver appeals and uniformed pay claims.

claim: DD Form 2789 is the waiver and remission application
quote: Requests for remission or cancellation ... must be submitted on forms designated by the respective Services and forwarded to the Service for processing. DFAS does not process remission or cancellation requests
fix: DD 2789 is the waiver application. Remission uses Service forms and does not go to DFAS.

claim: Debt classification list (military pay, travel, transportation, commissary, exchange, contractor)
quote: Ch 1 does not classify debts by type. Contractor debt is Ch 5.
fix: Cite the source or remove the claim that Ch 1 carries the classification.

claim: Hearing routes through DOHA for an independent decision
quote: The DFAS DCMO ... also makes determinations on hearing requests. Generally, DCMO hearing officials will process all requests for hearings.
fix: Service members get a review by the DCO under Ch 4 sec 6.0, then DCMO hearing officials. DOHA hears waiver appeals only. Marine mis-routes the 30-day petition if told DOHA.

claim: 30 days from the debt notification to petition for hearing or request review
quote: The request for review must be received not later than 30 days from the mailing date of the debt notification, or by the date indicated in the debt notification.
fix: Hearing petition is 30 calendar days from mailing. 45 days if records were requested first.

quote: Ch 4 uses 3.0 hearings, 6.0 reviews for members, 7.0 informal disputes, 8.0 waiver, 9.0 remission.
fix: Replace the legacy six-digit paragraph numbers with the current ones.

claim: Remission applies to enlisted Marines on active duty, hardship only
quote: Remission or cancellation is limited to debts resulting from overpayments of active duty pay.
fix: Remission covers any active duty pay overpayment for members of any grade. It excludes IDT and AT reservists. Hardship is not the test.

claim: Remission package submits to DFAS Indianapolis
quote: DFAS does not process remission or cancellation requests for any Service.
fix: Send remission to the Marine Corps through the Service channel. Waivers go to DCMO.

claim: Waiver on equity grounds, remission on hardship
quote: The standard is erroneous payment without fault, fraud, misrepresentation, or lack of good faith.
fix: Fix the stated tests.

claim: Hearing and waiver may run concurrently in the 30-day window
quote: By submitting an application for the waiver of a debt, an individual is acknowledging that he or she does not intend to dispute the validity or amount of the debt.
fix: Waiver concedes the debt. A concurrent hearing petition contradicts it. Brief the Marine before he or she files both.

claim: Waiver denial appeal window
quote: A debtor may appeal ... within 30 days of receipt of the written denial ... DCMO may extend ... up to an additional 30 calendar days
fix: Page gives no figure. Add 30 plus 30 days. Submit the appeal to DCMO, not DOHA.

claim: Page omits the waiver filing limit
quote: Military members must submit a waiver application within 5 years from the date the erroneous payment was discovered. The timeframe ... cannot be extended or waived.
fix: Add the 5-year limit.

claim: 30 days from demand letter to dispute, request hearing, waive, or arrange repayment
quote: The due date must not be more than 30 days from the date of the initial debt notification letter

claim: 15 percent of disposable pay cap
quote: All involuntary salary offset under 5 U.S.C. 5514 is limited to a maximum of 15 percent of the debtor disposable pay unless the debtor gives written consent
fix: Add the written-consent exception.

claim: Penalty after 90 days delinquent
quote: a penalty charge, not to exceed 6 percent per annum, on any portion of the debt that is delinquent more than 90 days

claim: Penalty fixed at 6 percent per annum
quote: not to exceed 6 percent per annum ... The Components may determine what percentage, up to the maximum 6 percent
fix: 6 percent is a ceiling.

claim: Treasury referral at 120 days delinquent
quote: Agencies are also required to refer any debts more than 120 days delinquent to TOP for recovery by centralized administrative offset.
fix: Cross-servicing is at 180 days (or 120 if no separate TOP referral).

claim: Credit bureau reporting at 60 days delinquent
quote: Federal agencies must report all delinquent debts to credit bureaus. ... debts incurred by Service members will not be reported ... during the time a decision regarding waiver or remission/cancellation of the debt is pending
fix: No 60-day figure exists. Add the 10 USC 2780(b) bar while a waiver or remission is pending.

claim: FPM Vol 1 para 120202: In-Service Debt Notification Letter in DTMS, 5 working days
quote: FPM Vol 1 is cached at .superpowers/text-cache/FPM/Vol 1.pdf.txt. Not opened in this pass.
fix: Re-check against FPM Vol 1 paras 120202, 120204, 200101.

claim: Reserve checkage over 50 dollars suspends for 75 days
quote: Not verified in this pass.
fix: Re-check against FPM Vol 1 para 200101.

claim: Treasury referral at 120 days with hearing and waiver rights preserved
quote: Once a debt is referred to Treasury, the DoD must cease collection activity related to that debt.
fix: Add that DoD stops its own collection once Treasury takes the debt.

claim: Interest from date of initial demand at CVFR
quote: interest rate, at a minimum, will be the same rate as the Current Value of Funds Rate (CVFR) ... N = Number of days delinquent (counted from the date of the debt notification)
fix: No interest if paid by the due date (3.2.6).

claim: DFAS reduces salary offset below 15 percent on hardship
quote: If the debtor contends that the rate of salary offset proposed ... would produce an extreme financial hardship ... the debtor may petition

claim: Administrative wage garnishment needs 30-day notice
quote: 31 USC 3720D not in the cache. Ch 4 sec 4.0 covers AWG hearings only.
fix: Cite 31 CFR 285.11.

claim: 15 percent of disposable pay cap
quote: limited to a maximum of 15 percent of the debtor disposable pay

claim: Cross-servicing referral at 120 days
quote: Agencies are required to refer eligible debts more than 180 days delinquent to the Treasury Cross-Servicing Program ... any debts more than 120 days delinquent to TOP
fix: TOP at 120 days, cross-servicing at 180 days. Fix the 120-day cross-servicing claim on this page.

claim: Page 11 entry on debt closeout per IRAM 4006
quote: Limit administrative remarks to matters forming an essential and permanent part of a Marine military history
fix: A debt closeout is not an authorized Page 11 entry.

claim: CVFR published annually and must be refreshed every accrual cycle
quote: The interest rate used to determine charges on a delinquent debt will remain fixed for the life of the debt.
fix: The rate is fixed for the life of the debt. Do not apply a new CVFR each cycle. Revise the CVFR pitfall.

claim: Interest from date of initial demand letter
quote: N = Number of days delinquent (counted from the date of the debt notification)
fix: Interest is not charged if paid by the due date.

claim: Penalty 6 percent after 90 days
quote: not to exceed 6 percent per annum ... to include interest and administrative charges
fix: 6 percent is a ceiling. Penalty base includes interest and administrative charges.

claim: Penalty accrues from the 90-day mark
quote: the DCO will assess a penalty ... on the unpaid portion of the debt accruing from the date of delinquency
fix: Penalty accrues from the date of delinquency.

claim: Administrative costs per DFAS Component schedule
quote: Components must calculate administrative charges based upon actual costs incurred
fix: Use actual cost.

claim: Waiver coverage of accrued interest, penalty, costs depends on the basis
quote: circumstances may justify a waiver of penalties ... but not a waiver of interest and administrative costs

claim: DFAS compromises accrued components
quote: The same organizational level ... authorized to approve compromises ... is authorized to approve waiver of the accrual of IPA charges.
fix: The DCO waives. Cite 4.0.

claim: Remission resolves full balance
quote: Generally, any indebtedness may be considered for remission or cancellation.
fix: No statement about components. Remove.

claim: Repayment capped at 15 percent of monthly pay
quote: limited to a maximum of 15 percent of the debtor disposable pay unless the debtor gives written consent
fix: The cap is 15 percent of disposable pay, not monthly pay, and member may consent to more.

claim: Waivers route through PAC and HQMC for larger debts
quote: If the aggregate amount of the debt is not more than ... $10,000 for military or National Guard members, the DCMO ... All applications are first submitted to DCMO.
fix: DCMO decides to $10,000. Above that DOHA decides. HQMC is not in the path.

claim: Waiver applies on administrative error and equity
quote: waiver ... erroneous payment ... without fault

claim: Remission is a distinct process with different routing
quote: Requests for remission or cancellation ... must be submitted on forms designated by the respective Services and forwarded to the Service for processing.

claim: Debt may include interest
quote: Interest charges will be accrued and assessed on all debt not paid in full by the date due

claim: Formula uses 12 months of basic pay per year of service
quote: multiply the sum of the highest applicable basic pay amount for 2 months by the number of combined years (but not over 19)
fix: Multiply 2 months of basic pay by years of service. Example becomes 8 x 2 x 4,500 = 72,000 dollars. Page overstates by a factor of six.

claim: Worked example yields 432,000 dollars
quote: multiply ... basic pay amount ... for 2 months by the number of combined years
fix: Correct amount is 72,000 dollars before tax.

claim: Minimum years for computation is 6
quote: Six years in the case of ... combat-related operations; or Three years in the case of any other member.
fix: Minimum is 3 years, or 6 years for combat-related or combat-zone disability.

claim: Maximum years 19
quote: The maximum number of years of service for computing the disability severance pay will be 19 years.

claim: Cap is the last 19 years of service
quote: combined years (but not over 19)
fix: The cap is 19 years counted. It has no connection to the last 19 years.

fix: Verify against 10 USC 1203 and 1212.

claim: Taxable unless exempt
quote: not subject to tax withholding or reporting if ... combat-related injury ... or ... entitled to disability compensation as determined by the VA or has received a proposed disability rating from the VA
fix: Exemption comes from combat-related injury or a VA entitlement or proposed rating. CRSC is not the test.

claim: Withholding on the lump sum
quote: Income taxes are withheld from all payments of disability severance pay unless the member qualifies for an exemption under subparagraph 5.4.1.

claim: VA recoups severance pay from VA compensation
